newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total forms LPG venture in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Total forms LPG venture in Vietnam.

text.p: Total said on Monday it planned to form a joint venture with its Vietnamese partner Tradimexco to import and market liquefied petroleum gas (LPG).
It said in a statement that it would own 70 percent of the venture, Total Gas Haiphong.

"Construction will begin in the next few weeks of an LPG centre, comprising receiving terminal, an initial storage depot with a capacity of 1,000 tons, and a bottle-filling unit. The total investment is estimated at 60 million francs," Total said in a statement. The venture will be based in Haiphong.
Total said Vietnam's Investment Ministry had approved the deal.
The French energy company opened an LPG centre in Ho Chi Minh City last October and plans more such deals in Vietnam.

"With agreements already signed in China and India, Total's LPG business is experiencing fast growth in Asia, where these products' ease of use and environmental friendliness are decisive factors," it said.
